gpu_tip: ~118GB total at 128K context — near-lossless, with Unsloth's dynamic layout keeping the most sensitive tensors above 6-bit. A 16GB GPU (e.g. RTX 5080) keeps the shared layers fast, with llama.cpp offloading the rest of the experts to a 128GB DDR5 kit; 192GB leaves real headroom.
mac_tip: Needs ~118GB — right at the edge of a 128GB MacBook Pro (M4 Max or M5 Max); a Mac Studio with 192GB+ is comfortable.
